jsonld.name: AnyLopez Botox & Fillers
jsonld.description: Botox & Fillers catalogue at AnyLopez Aesthetic Clinic Benidorm: Botox, hyaluronic acid, thread lifts and PRP. Diagnosis before injection, branded products and conservative techniques.

faq.a: Botox relaxes muscles (forehead, frown lines, crow's feet). Hyaluronic acid restores lost volume (folds, lips, contour). During the diagnosis we identify what you actually need — often it's both, in different areas.
Minimally. The needles are extremely fine. In sensitive areas we apply a numbing cream beforehand. Most patients describe the sensation as a brief pinch.

Botox: progressive effect between day 3 and day 14 (full effect at 2 weeks). Hyaluronic acid: visible within hours, full effect at 2-4 weeks. Threads: immediate lifting plus collagen stimulation at 3 months. PRP: results at 4-6 weeks.
Botox: 4-6 months depending on area. Hyaluronic acid: 6-12 months depending on product. Barbed threads: 12-18 months. PRP: 6-12 months with maintenance sessions.
Injectables are contraindicated during pregnancy and breastfeeding. We wait until you finish breastfeeding before starting any plan.

hero.imgAlt_html: Botox & Fillers at AnyLopez Aesthetic Clinic Benidorm
hero.h1_html: Volume, not excess. Subtle, technical, your own.
hero.lead: Botox to soften lines, hyaluronic acid to restore volume, thread lifts to reposition, PRP to regenerate. Each one has its precise moment in your face — and that moment is what separates a natural result from a frozen one.

pain.eyebrow: Does any of this sound familiar?
pain.h2: Most patients who come to us have been through the same thing.
pain.p_html: You don't arrive out of nowhere. You arrive after hesitating, comparing and worrying about overdoing it.

items.h3_html: You've stayed away for fear it will show.
items.p_html: You've seen exaggerated cheekbones, over-projected lips, frozen foreheads — and you don't want that. But you also won't accept your face ageing without a real option.

items.h3_html: You've seen mask-like results and run away.
items.p_html: The "done" look is a sign of injection without judgement. Well-applied aesthetic medicine shows because you look rested, not different.

items.h3_html: You don't know whether you need Botox, hyaluronic acid or something else entirely.
items.p_html: You've read everything, got more confused, and can't decide because every professional recommends their own thing. An honest diagnosis ends that doubt.

why.h2_html: Six reasons it works here where it doesn't elsewhere.
why.p_html: This isn't marketing. It's medical diagnosis, traceable brands and conservative technique.

items.p_html: We look at what you ACTUALLY need — not what sells best. Sometimes it isn't Botox; sometimes it's hyaluronic acid. Sometimes it's neither.
Vistabel, Restylane, Juvederm — clinically validated products. Every batch is registered. No "generics" or recycled product.
Better a little with a 15-day review than overdoing it on the first session. Progressive filler (layer by layer), never pumping up the face.

items.h3: The full palette in a single plan
items.p_html: Botox + hyaluronic acid + threads + PRP — combined when your case calls for it. We design a sequence that multiplies results.
We adjust until you're satisfied. It's not a one-day sale — it's follow-up of the result.
Qualified doctors, not beauty therapists with a weekend course. The same standard as everywhere else in the clinic.

xsell.eyebrow: If your case goes beyond filling
xsell.p: Hyaluronic acid restores volume, but deep sagging is treated with technology. Combining injectables with Ultherapy HIFU or INDIBA Radiofrequency amplifies the results.

process.h2: Four steps. No surprises, no small print.
process.p: Medical diagnosis before any needle — and a review included after the session.

steps.p_html: A call or WhatsApp to find a slot. 30 minutes at the clinic, no cost, no commitment.
A qualified aesthetic doctor evaluates your case: areas to treat, expectations, history. If your goal isn't injectable, we tell you.

steps.h3: Sequenced plan with brand and dose
steps.p_html: We design which product, how much and in what order — always conservative. You know exactly what goes in and why.
We meet again to adjust whatever's needed. The result is fine-tuned; it isn't closed on day one.
